views.rationale: AAPL's 2% net sales growth in Americas segment outpaces CAT's 4% decline in sales volume.
AMZN's 7% cost of sales growth is lower than CVX's 20% increase in depreciation, depletion and amortization.
BA's 9.8% cost of sales as a percentage of Revenues is higher than BAC's 14% return on average allocated capital.
GOOGL's operating margin increased 4% to 32%, outpacing GS's 34% increase in operating income.
GOOGL's 15% revenue growth outpaced JNJ's 4% increase in sales to customers.
GS's 8% increase in net revenue was lower than JPM's 12% increase in net revenue.
JNJ's 69.3% gross profit margin was higher than KO's 68.6% gross profit margin.
KO's 2% increase in net operating revenues was lower than LIN's 2% increase in sales.
